name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 to land-holding farmer families to meet agricultural expenses.
eligibility: All land-holding farmer families in India
Excluded: income tax payers, government employees, constitutional post holders
benefits: ₹6,000/year (₹2,000 every 4 months) directly to Aadhaar-linked bank account
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or pmkisan.gov.in

name: PM Awas Yojana Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/NE/difficult areas) for construction of pucca houses to rural homeless families.
eligibility: Houseless families or families in kutcha/dilapidated houses as per SECC 2011
SC/ST families, freed bonded labourers, minorities prioritized
Must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
benefits: ₹1.20-1.30 lakh for house construction + 90-95 days MGNREGS labour support
how_to_apply: Apply through Gram Panchayat or pmayg.nic.in

name: PM Awas Yojana Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Credit Linked Subsidy for home loans and financial assistance to urban poor for affordable housing.
eligibility: EWS: Annual income up to ₹3 lakh
LIG: Annual income ₹3 lakh to ₹6 lakh
Must not own a pucca house in India
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on home loans up to ₹6 lakh
how_to_apply: Apply through banks, housing finance companies or pmaymis.gov.in

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Free food grain of 5 kg per person per month to National Food Security Act (NFSA) beneficiaries under one nation one ration card.
eligibility: Covered under National Food Security Act (NFSA)
benefits: 5 kg free rice/wheat/coarse grains per person per month
how_to_apply: No application needed. Collect from designated Fair Price Shop (FPS) with ration card.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Zero-balance savings bank account with RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accidental insurance, ₹30,000 life insurance, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen above 10 years of age
Does not already have a bank account
No minimum balance or income requirement
benefits: Zero balance account + RuPay card + ₹2L accident insurance + ₹10K overdraft
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent (BC) outlet

name: PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free micro-loans for small businesses. Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50K-₹5L), Tarun (₹5L-₹10L).
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small or micro enterprises
benefits: Loans up to ₹10 lakh without collateral for business purposes
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank, NBFC, MFI branch or mudra.org.in

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Cashless health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at 25,000+ empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Bottom 40% of India's population as per SECC data
Rural: D1 to D5 deprivation categories in SECC
Urban: 11 occupational categories listed in SECC
No family size, age, or gender restriction
benefits: ₹5 lakh/family/year cashless treatment including medicines, diagnostics, and post-care
documents: Ration Card or SECC beneficiary letter
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or visit any empanelled hospital

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60 for unorganised sector workers, with spouse and nominee benefits.
eligibility: Must have a savings bank account
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension ₹1,000-₹5,000 after 60 + ₹2L death benefit to nominee
how_to_apply: Enroll through any bank branch, internet banking, or mobile banking app

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Voluntary pension scheme for unorganised workers with guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60.
eligibility: Not covered under ESIC, EPFO, NPS, or income tax payer
benefits: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension after 60 + ₹1,500/month for spouse on death
documents: Savings bank account or Jan Dhan account
how_to_apply: Enroll at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or maandhan.in

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance at very low premium (1.5-5%) protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Sharecroppers and tenant farmers also eligible
benefits: Full insured sum on crop failure from natural causes including drought, flood, cyclone, hailstorm
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest bank, CSC, or online at pmfby.gov.in before cut-off date

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Schemes
description: Single platform for 50+ central and state scholarships for Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, and Merit-cum-Means students from all categories.
eligibility: Indian students at various education levels
Family income criteria varies by scheme (₹1-2.5 lakh/year)
benefits: Scholarships from ₹1,000 to ₹20,000/year + tuition fees in some schemes
how_to_apply: Register and apply at scholarships.gov.in

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Accidental death and disability insurance of ₹2 lakh at just ₹20/year premium for bank account holders.
benefits: ₹2 lakh on accidental death / total disability; ₹1 lakh on partial disability
how_to_apply: Enroll through bank branch, net banking, or mobile banking at ₹20/year

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance coverage of ₹2 lakh for death from any cause at ₹436/year premium for bank account holders.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life insurance for any cause of death to nominee
how_to_apply: Enroll through any bank branch or online banking at ₹436/year

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing and health cards with crop-wise recommendations for fertilizers and nutrients to improve farm productivity.
benefits: Free soil testing + nutrient recommendations + soil health card every 2 years
how_to_apply: Contact nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Agriculture office

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGS (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
eligibility: Adult members willing to do unskilled manual work
benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment/year at state minimum wages (₹200-350/day)
how_to_apply: Register at Gram Panchayat office or nregastrep.nic.in

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Free short-term skill training in market-relevant skills with certification, ₹8,000 reward, and placement assistance for youth.
eligibility: Class 10 pass (preferred, not mandatory for some trades)
benefits: Free skill training (3 months) + ₹8,000 reward + government-recognized certificate + placement support
how_to_apply: Find nearest training centre at pmkvyofficial.org or call 08800055555

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
description: Scheme to prevent gender-biased sex selective elimination and ensure education and welfare of the girl child.
eligibility: Families in districts with low Child Sex Ratio (CSR)
benefits: Awareness campaigns, conditional cash transfers, education incentives for girl children
how_to_apply: Register at Anganwadi centre or contact district administration

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: High-interest savings scheme (8.2% p.a.) for girl children with tax exemption, to secure their education and marriage expenses.
eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age
One account per girl child, maximum 2 girls per family
benefits: 8.2% interest p.a. (highest among small savings) + tax deduction u/s 80C + tax-free maturity
how_to_apply: Open account at any post office or authorised bank

name: National Pension System (NPS)
description: Voluntary, long-term retirement savings scheme regulated by PFRDA, with market-linked returns and tax benefits.
benefits: Market-linked returns + tax deduction up to ₹2 lakh/year under 80C + 80CCD(1B)
how_to_apply: Register online at enps.nsdl.com or through any bank/post office

name: PM SVAMITVA Scheme
description: Drone mapping of rural inhabited areas to provide property cards (rights of record) to village households.
eligibility: Residents of rural inhabited land (abadi areas)
benefits: Legal property ownership card + ability to use property as collateral for bank loans
how_to_apply: Property cards issued automatically once village is surveyed. Check svamitva.nic.in

name: PM Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Subsidy (15-35%) on project cost (up to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 lakh for service) to set up new micro-enterprises.
eligibility: Individuals above 18 years with minimum VIII standard pass
No income limit; new enterprises only
benefits: 15-35% capital subsidy on project cost up to ₹50 lakh/₹20 lakh
how_to_apply: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in or at nearest KVIC/KVIB/DIC office

name: PM Jan Aushadhi Pariyojana
description: Generic medicines sold at up to 90% less than branded price at over 10,000 Jan Aushadhi Kendras across India.
benefits: Generic medicines up to 90% cheaper than branded alternatives
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra. Find location at janaushadhi.gov.in

name: Stand Up India
description: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.
eligibility: Not defaulter in any bank/financial institution
benefits: Loan of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore with 7-year repayment for manufacturing/service/trading
how_to_apply: Apply online at standupmitra.in or visit any bank branch

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Free skill training and placement for rural poor youth aged 15-35 years in market-driven sectors with mandatory job placement.
eligibility: MGNREGS job card holder families preferred
benefits: Free residential training + stipend + placement guarantee + post-placement support
how_to_apply: Contact Project Implementing Agency (PIA) in your district or ddugky.gov.in

name: National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
description: Promotes self-help groups (SHGs) of rural women, provides credit linkage, subsidized loans, and livelihood support.
eligibility: Must form or join a Self-Help Group (SHG)
No income limit for SHG formation
benefits: SHG loans at 7% interest, revolving fund of ₹15,000, CIF grants up to ₹50,000
how_to_apply: Contact Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) or Gram Panchayat or aajeevika.gov.in

name: e-Shram Portal Registration
description: National database for unorganised workers providing unique UAN number and access to social security schemes.
eligibility: Includes construction workers, domestic workers, street vendors, farmers, fishermen, etc.
benefits: Unique UAN number + ₹2L accident insurance (PMSBY) + priority access to government schemes
how_to_apply: Self-register at eshram.gov.in or via CSC

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Free LPG connection (deposit-free) to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) and other deprived households.
benefits: Free LPG connection + first refill + stove (optional loan)
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest LPG distributor or online at pmuy.gov.in

name: Saubhagya Scheme (PM Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana)
description: Universal household electrification scheme providing free electricity connections to all unelectrified households in rural and urban areas.
eligibility: All unelectrified households in rural areas
Poor urban households without electricity connection
benefits: Free electricity connection + LED bulb + mobile charging point for BPL households
how_to_apply: Contact nearest electricity distribution company (DISCOM) or saubhagya.gov.in

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Tap water connection to every rural household by 2024 with service level of 55 LPCD (litres per capita per day).
eligibility: All rural households without functional household tap connections
benefits: Household tap water connection with safe drinking water supply
how_to_apply: Register with Gram Panchayat / Village Water & Sanitation Committee (VWSC)

name: Swachh Bharat Mission Gramin (SBM-G)
description: Financial assistance of ₹12,000 to rural households for construction of individual household toilets (IHHL).
eligibility: SC/ST, small/marginal farmers, physically handicapped households prioritized
benefits: ₹12,000 incentive for toilet construction (paid directly to beneficiary after completion)
how_to_apply: Apply at Gram Panchayat or through Swachh Bharat Mission app

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Flexible credit for farmers at subsidized interest rate (4-7% p.a.) for crop cultivation, post-harvest, allied activities, and personal needs.
eligibility: Self-Help Groups and Joint Liability Groups of farmers
Animal husbandry and fishery farmers also eligible
benefits: Credit limit based on land holding + interest subvention keeping rate at 4% p.a.
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest bank branch or rural cooperative bank

name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana
description: Pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing ₹3,000/month after age 60.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers aged 18-40 years
Not covered under other pension schemes like EPFO/NPS/ESIC
benefits: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension after 60 years with government matching contribution
how_to_apply: Enroll at nearest CSC or maandhan.in

name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
description: Free hot cooked meal to students of Classes 1-8 in government and government-aided schools to improve attendance and nutrition.
eligibility: Government, government-aided, and local body schools
Also covers special training centres and Madrasa supported under SSA
benefits: Free nutritious cooked meal daily + improved attendance + better nutrition status
how_to_apply: Automatic for enrolled students in government schools. No application needed.

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
description: Integrated scheme for school education covering Pre-primary to Class 12, providing free textbooks, uniforms, transport, and hostel facilities.
eligibility: Students from Class 1 to 12 in government schools
Girls, SC/ST, differently-abled students get priority support
Free and compulsory education under RTE for Classes 1-8
benefits: Free textbooks, 2 uniforms/year, free bicycles for girls in Class 9, scholarship support
how_to_apply: Automatic for enrolled students. Contact school or district education office.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly pension for BPL elderly citizens aged 60+ years: ₹200/month (60-79 years) and ₹500/month (80+ years).
eligibility: BPL elderly citizens aged 60 years and above
Listed in SECC 2011 / identified by state BPL list
No other regular pension or income support
benefits: ₹200/month (60-79 yrs) + state top-up; ₹500/month (80+ yrs) + state top-up
how_to_apply: Apply at Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office or nsap.nic.in

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Monthly pension of ₹300+ for BPL persons with severe/multiple disabilities aged 18-79 years.
eligibility: 80% or more disability or multiple disabilities
Listed in SECC / state BPL list
benefits: ₹300/month central assistance + state top-up (varies by state)
how_to_apply: Apply at Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office or nsap.nic.in

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGWPS)
description: Monthly pension of ₹300+ for BPL widows aged 40-79 years.
eligibility: Listed in SECC 2011 / state BPL list
benefits: ₹300/month central assistance + state top-up
how_to_apply: Apply at Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office or nsap.nic.in

name: National Food Security Act (NFSA) – Ration Card
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Subsidized food grains at ₹1-3/kg for beneficiaries under Priority Household (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) categories.
eligibility: PHH: 75% of rural and 50% of urban population
AAY: Poorest of the poor families, 35 kg/family/month
benefits: Rice at ₹3/kg, Wheat at ₹2/kg, Coarse grains at ₹1/kg under NFSA
how_to_apply: Apply at Food Supply Department / District Supply Office of your state

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendors Loan)
description: Collateral-free working capital loan for street vendors: ₹10,000 (1st), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd) at 7% subsidized interest.
eligibility: Urban street vendors with vending certificate or identity card
Vendors with Letter of Recommendation from ULB/Town Vending Committee
benefits: Loans at 7% interest + cashback on digital payments + credit score building
how_to_apply: Apply at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through MFI / bank

name: NRLM Women Entrepreneurs (Lakhpati Didi)
description: Targets converting 3 crore rural women SHG members into 'Lakhpati Didis' earning ₹1 lakh+ annually through skill training and enterprise support.
eligibility: Priority to SC/ST, BPL, and minority women
benefits: Skills training + drone pilot certification + enterprise support + credit access
how_to_apply: Through Gram Panchayat or Block Mission Management Unit

name: PM Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
description: Free digital literacy training to 6 crore rural households to make them IT literate and capable of using digital financial services.
eligibility: Priority to SC/ST, minorities, BPL, women, differently-abled
benefits: Free 20-hour digital training + government certificate + access to digital services
how_to_apply: Register at pmgdisha.in or contact nearest CSC

name: Scholarships for Minority Students
description: Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, and Merit-cum-Means scholarships for students belonging to minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Zoroastrian).
eligibility: Merit-cum-Means: Technical courses, family income < ₹2.5 lakh/year
benefits: ₹1,000-₹12,000/year depending on level + hostel allowance
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in (NSP portal)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance to OBC students pursuing post-matric education to enable them to complete their education.
eligibility: Family income below ₹2.5 lakh per year
Must have cleared previous class examination
benefits: Maintenance allowance ₹230-1,200/month + reader charges + study tour charges
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in (NSP portal)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Full fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for SC students pursuing post-matric education.
eligibility: Family income below ₹2.5 lakh per year
benefits: Full fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance ₹380-1,200/month
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in (NSP portal)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
description: Post-matric scholarships for ST students for studies from Class 11 to PhD level with full fee and maintenance support.
eligibility: Family income below ₹2.5 lakh per year
benefits: Full fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in (NSP portal)

name: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV)
description: Residential schools for girls from disadvantaged sections (SC/ST/OBC/minority/BPL) at elementary level in educationally backward blocks.
eligibility: Located in blocks with low female literacy (under 30%)
benefits: Free residential education + food + clothing + study materials
how_to_apply: Contact District Education Office or Gram Panchayat

name: Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
description: Holistic development of tribal regions covering education, health, livelihood, and infrastructure across 117 tribal districts.
benefits: Convergence of 40+ schemes: housing, water, sanitation, education, health, roads for tribal areas
how_to_apply: Contact District Collector or Tribal Department office

name: Nai Manzil Scheme
description: Integrated education and livelihood initiative for minority youth who dropped out of madrasas or formal schools (below Class 8).
eligibility: Dropped out before Class 8 or madrasa educated
benefits: Free bridge course + Class 8/10 certificate + 6-month skill training + placement
how_to_apply: Contact implementing agency or Ministry of Minority Affairs

name: PM ABHYUDAYA (Free Coaching for Competitive Exams)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Free coaching for SC/ST/OBC/EBC/DNT/Transgender students for competitive exams like UPSC, SSC, banking, engineering, medical.
benefits: Free coaching for UPSC/SSC/banking/engineering/medical + ₹3,000/month stipend
how_to_apply: Apply online at coaching.dosje.gov.in

name: Direct Benefit Transfer for Fertilizers (DBT-Fertilizer)
description: Subsidized fertilizers sold directly to farmers at government-fixed rates through Point of Sale (PoS) machines at retail shops using Aadhaar authentication.
eligibility: No specific eligibility; based on Aadhaar authentication at purchase
benefits: Urea at ₹266.50/bag (50 kg) vs market price; DAP, MOP, NPK at highly subsidized rates
documents: Aadhaar Card (for biometric at POS machine)
how_to_apply: Visit nearest fertilizer retailer with Aadhaar card

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Government shares 25% of prescribed stipend (max ₹1,500/month) with employers who train apprentices on-the-job.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 14-21 years (up to 45 for SC/ST/Divyangjan)
Minimum Class 5 pass for certain trades
Must not be in full-time schooling/regular college
benefits: Hands-on industry training + monthly stipend + NCVT/SCVT certificate
how_to_apply: Register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in

name: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - Urban (DAY-NULM)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Urban poverty alleviation through SHG formation, skill training, self-employment loans, and shelter for urban homeless.
eligibility: Street vendors, rag pickers, construction workers
benefits: SHG loans at 7% interest + skill training + self-employment loans + shelter homes
how_to_apply: Contact Urban Local Body (ULB) / City Mission Management Unit

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) under NHM
description: Cash incentive to pregnant women for institutional delivery to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.
eligibility: All pregnant women delivering in government health facilities
BPL pregnant women in private accredited facilities
Rural LPS women: ₹1,400; Urban LPS women: ₹1,000
benefits: ₹1,000-1,400 cash incentive + free delivery + ASHA worker support
how_to_apply: Register with ASHA worker or Primary Health Centre (PHC)

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit of ₹5,000 (+ ₹6,000 under JSY for institutional delivery) to pregnant and lactating women for first live birth.
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating women for first live birth
Not employed in central/state government (covered under Maternity Benefit Act)
benefits: ₹5,000 in 3 instalments (₹1,000 + ₹2,000 + ₹2,000) directly to bank account
how_to_apply: Register at Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or health facility

name: POSHAN Abhiyaan (National Nutrition Mission)
description: Convergence programme to reduce stunting, undernutrition, anaemia in children (0-6 years), adolescent girls, and pregnant/lactating mothers.
eligibility: Special focus on tribal, difficult, and NE regions
benefits: Supplementary nutrition + growth monitoring + nutrition counselling + Iron/Folic Acid supplements
how_to_apply: Register with nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC)
